description: Windows desktop control for AI agents: screen, UI Automation, input, processes, files, shell.
name: io.github.sitharaj88/winctl

environmentVariables.description: Permission profile: readonly (observation only), standard (adds desktop interaction and file access), or full (adds process control and shell execution). Defaults to standard.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated capability tiers, overriding the profile. Any of: observe, interact, filesystem, manage, shell.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_TIERS

environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated folders that file tools may access. Empty means the whole filesystem except protected Windows system directories.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_ALLOWED_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip user confirmation prompts for destructive actions. Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_CONFIRM_DESTRUCTIVE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSONL audit log. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\winctl\audit.jsonl.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_AUDIT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Screenshots are downscaled to at most this width in pixels. Defaults to 1600.
environmentVariables.name: WINCTL_MAX_IMAGE_WIDTH

title: WinCtl
